title: Hy Utkale Purushottamat
subtitle: Śrī Chaitanya Gauḍīya Maṭha
description: Hy Utkale Purushottamat — a themed treasury of teachings gathered by the Śrī Chaitanya Gauḍīya Maṭha.

articles.title: On the Appearance Day of Srila Prabhupad
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: In the initial part of the harikatha Srila Gurudev narrates how Srila Param Gurudev acquired the appearance place of Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati Thakur at Puri-dham. Then he narrates the incidence of Lord Jagannath staying three days in front of Srila Bhaktivinod Thakur’s house at Puri when Srila Saraswati Thakur was of six months. He also narrates how Srila Saraswati Thakur approached Srila Gaura Kishor Das Babaji repeatedly for accepting him as his Gurudev.

blocks.text: I had never thought that for the celebration of the appearance day of our Param Gurudev (Prabhupad), for his Vyasa Puja, we would come to Ludhiana, Punjab. Everything happens by the Divine arrangements of the Supreme Lord. Usually, we do not come to Punjab during this time. Everything happens by the desire of the Supreme Lord. Without His will even a leaf of a tree cannot move. We had planned to stay in Sarbhog, Assam for our Param Gurudev’s appearance day, the place where he has established Sri Gandharvika Giridhari deities.

Srila Prabhupad appeared in Jagannath Dham, Purushottam Dham. Our Gurudev procured his birthplace. We cannot even imagine how difficult it was to procure that place. No one was ready to endeavor to procure that place. Even ISKCON ran away from there. There were so many tenants who occupied that place since more than forty years. It was very difficult to draw them away from that place. Then many of the God-brothers of Guruji came to him and requested him to take that task in his hand. Our Guruji had a special characteristic, whatever he speaks, he would do that. He always considered himself to be the servant of Vaishnavas and lived his full life to fulfill their desires. He did not even want to go hospital when he was enacting the pastimes of illness. Many dignitaries from Kolkata advised him to install a pacemaker in his heart, so we requested him to be admitted in hospital. He said, “I do not want to get admitted in hospital but as you are desiring so I will get admitted.”

So, throughout his life, he acted to fulfill the desires of the Vaishnavas. I have Bengali accent so you have to listen very attentively. If you do not pay proper attention then you might not understand. So Srila Gurudev took responsibility to vacate that place and take custody of it. His health was not good at that time but as he decided to do this seva, he did not care for it. There were so many challenges involved in acquiring that place that it was almost impossible to make it happen.

I requested Guruji, “No one is worried about acquiring that place. Your health is not good. So I request you to not take such a hard work. There are no proper arrangements here for your stay also.” Gurudev did not talk anything on that topic, rather, he told me to write an application to Sri Sadashiva Tripathi, the Chief Minister of Orissa at that time. Gurudev told, “He will also meet the commissioner of endowments.” All the arrangements were made to meet the Chief Minister and commissioner of endowments. I was there with him. I will not speak this in detail. Many big personalities like Rangnath Mishra, the Chief Justice of Supreme Court and Gangadhar Mahapatro, education minister and many others came in the full support of Guruji. Would such personalities come in support of any ordinary person like me? But, being attracted by Gurudev’s exalted personality, they came behind him. Our Guruji’s personality is such that whoever sees him, immediately becomes attracted. After Srila Gurudev procured that place, the advocate of the opposite party said, “I cannot imagine, how did you do this? The tenants occupied the place for more than forty years, even by the eviction order from court, it was impossible to take charge of that place.” As Gurudev had decided to do so, Lord Jagannath and his Gurudev Srila Prabhupad, came to his support and made the impossible task possible.

We got the place and all the tenants went away and later a big temple was established there. It has become an international place now because people from all over the world visit it. It is in our Gurudev’s character that whichever task he takes in his hand, he would complete it.

We have not seen his Gurudev (Prabhupad). People used to understand Srila Gurudev to be the son of Param Gurudev because of his resemblance with Srila Prabhupad. Our Param Gurudev was ajanulambit bahu—whose arms extend down to the knees with gaurkanti—golden yellow complexion. He had a very tall attractive figure. Our Gurudev had exact resemblance to him. Whoever had darshan of him, they know about him. Param Gurudev and Gurudev are not ordinary persons even by their external appearance.

I never thought that for the celebration of appearance day and Vyasa Puja of our Param Gurudev, we would come to Ludhiana and even in Ludhiana we would come to Krishna temple in Model Town. Our Gurudev used to come Ludhiana since 1972 and continued to come till 1978. That time the program used to be at Sanatan Dharma temple in old town. Mangat Rayji used to give all the expenditures for the program. We stayed at his house. Sri Narendra Kapoor, Narhari Dasadhikari the father of Sri Rakesh Kapoor, Radhamadhav Dasadhikar brought our Guruji here for the first time. Later also we used to come every year. Today on this special Tithi, our coming here in Krishna temple is by the desire of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna. Gurudev had set his holy feet here continuously for seven years. It may be the desire of our Gurudev that the appearance day of his Gurudev gets celebrated here, so he made such arrangements and brought us here on the pretext of my treatment.

I do not have the eligibility to sing glories of Parama Gurudev, only his personal associate can sing his glories. He was not an ordinary person. He is a personal associate of Supreme Lord. He appeared 500 years after the appearance of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu Who preached the loving devotion to Supreme Lord Sri Krishna throughout the world. Mahaprabhu manifested Radha-kunda, Shyam-kunda and other pastimes places of RadhaKrishna making His associates, Rupa Goswami and Sanatan Goswami as the medium. He distributed the Divine Love to all, wherever He went and to whoever He came in contact with irrespective of cast, creed and religion. Not only to human beings, He distributed the Divine Love even to the animals like lions, leopards, elephants, deer and others, while going to Vrindavan through the jungle of Jharkhand. While going through the path of jungle, He was calling out Supreme Lord Sri Krishna in intense mood of separation,

He was crying in separation mood. The animals there also started calling out, “Krishna! Krishna!” Can an ordinary person make the animals utter Supreme Lord’s Name? Ferocious animals like leopards, lions, tigers etc., they are walking together with deer and kissing each other, is such a thing possible? Yes, it is because the eternal nature of the soul was manifested. They have realized that, “I am not a tiger”, “I am not a deer”, “I am of the Supreme Lord”, “We are related with each other through Supreme Lord.”

Because of Mahaprabhu’s bringing the flood of Divine Love, many Muslims and Mallecha also became His great devotees. But after the disappearance of Sri Krishna Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, the Six Goswamis, Srinivas Acharya, Narottam Das Thakura and Shyamananda Prabhu and His other personal associates, a dark age descended on the world of Gaudiya Vaishnavism. Even the people of Bengal, Nadiya, Nabdwip where Mahaprabhu descended, they also did not understand the gravity of the teachings of the doctrine of pure devotion propagated by Mahaprabhu. People of Bengal did not understand the doctrine of universal, all-embracing, all-accommodating Divine Love. Why did that happen? We should deeply think about that. Was there no scholar that time? Was there no Bhagavatam that time? Or the books of Six Goswamis, Chaitanya Charitamrit or Chaintanya Bhagavat? Everything was there, but no one could understand the doctrine of pure devotion. And because of that numerous pseudo-sects or apasampradayas cropped up. They claimed that they also preach the message of Mahaprabhu but they are practicing and spreading the opposite of His real teachings. Wearing the cloths of Babaji, they associate with woman and try to imitate the intimate loving pastimes of RadhaKrishna. Though they themselves pose as learned scholars, they are characterless, they do not understand the actual teachings of Mahaprabhu. By seeing the behavior of these anti-devotional ideological people, the residence of Bengal misunderstood the teachings of Mahaprabhu and lost their faith. The general class of people thought the behavior and followings of the pseudo-sect people were the teachings of Mahaprabhu.
Totaram Das Babaji Maharaj named thirteen such pseudo-sects and prohibited everyone from associating with them,

lines: āul, bāul, kartābhajā, neṛā, daraveśa, sain
totā kahe ei teror saṅga nāhi kari

blocks.text: Do not associate with people who are from those thirteen apasampradayas.

Mahaprabhu knew that nobody has understood and in future nobody will understand the real implication of His teachings by reading them from books, as conditioned souls have a misconception of self, and different worldly motives. He then decided to send someone amongst His associates to rescue the fallen souls and sent Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur to this world. Accepting him, Srila Saraswati Thakur appeared in this world in Purushottam Dham. He is a follower of Rupa Goswami. He is Nayanmani Manjari in Krishna-lila. Mahaprabhu sent them, He told them, “You have to go to propagate My message otherwise worldly people will not understand the real implication of the scriptures.” By the order of Mahaprabhu, Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur appeared in Ula-gram (village) of Virnagar Dham in Nadiya district.

And by accepting Bhaktivinoda Thakur and Bhagavati devi as parents, our Param Gurudev, Srila Bhakti Siddhant Saraswati Thakur appeared in Purushottam Dham at the place where Sree Chaitanya Gaudiya Math was established. Previously, that place was known as ‘Narayan Chhata Math’. We used to offer the obeisance there but that time it was not a clean place because of dirty gutters passing through there.

When our Param Gurudev appeared, everyone was amazed to see that natural marks of sacred thread around his transcendental body. Six months after the appearance of the child, it was time for the Rathayatra festival. Ratha travels from Jagannath temple to Gundicha temple on Grand Road. That year, by Lord Jagannath’s desire, the Chariots of Balaram and Shubhdra went ahead but Lord Jagannath’s chariot stopped in front of Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur’s house and simply would not move forward. Lord Jagannath Deva stayed motionless in front of the Narayan Chhata there for three whole days. Under Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakura’s direction, a kirtan festival was held in front of the Deity for the entire three-day period. On the third day, the six-month old baby came before Lord Jagannath in the arms of his mother, he grabbed Jagannath Deva’s feet and took the garland from around the Deity’s neck. And then only the chariot started moving ahead. These pastimes are beyond our understanding. It is written in Padma Puran ‘hy utkale purushottamat—pure devotion will get propagated to the whole world from Purushottam Dham. Srila Bhakti Siddhant Saraswati Thakur appeared in Purushottam Dham and thus pure devotion was spread throughout the whole world from Purushottam Dham. He is the fountain-head of all the Maths, Chaitanya Math, Chaitanya Gaudiya Matha, Iskcon etc.

In 1881, Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakura started construction of Bhakti Bhavan in Kolkata’s Ram Bagan district. During the digging of the building’s foundations, a deity of Kurmadeva was found. Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakura taught his seven-year-old son the rules for worshiping a deity and gave the Mantra to worship Kurmadeva. He also gave him instructions to regularly wear Tilak and to follow other Vaishnava etiquettes. While Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakura was living in Serampore, he came back one day from a visit to Puri with a garland of Tulasi leave’s beads. He gave it to Prabhupad, and initiated him in the chanting of the Holy Name and the Nrsimha Mantra.

When Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur shifted his residence to Godrumdvipa in Nabdvipa Dham, Nadiya district, Prabhupad also came along with him. Prabhupad in his eternal form is Nayanmani Manjari who is serving the Lord under the guidance of Kamal Manjari.

Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur wrote more than hundred books in Bengali, Sanskrit and English. Srila Thakura then visited Kuliya, where the modern city of Nabdvipa stands. He went on the roof of his place of stay, to take a view of the Dham’s beauty. At about ten o’clock at night, when the thick clouds darkened the sky, he saw an illuminated building on the other side of the river. He was astonished to see it. On inquiry the next day, they learnt that the light was coming from a place known as Ballal Dighi. Going later to Ballal Dighi, they learnt from the elderly residents of the village that this was Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu’s birthplace. Intrigued, Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakura began to research old maps and documents and was able to establish conclusively that it was Mayapur, Mahaprabhu’s birthplace. When Jagannath Das Babaji visited that place and danced in ecstasy, it was fully confirmed that it is Mahaprabhu’s birthplace. Then a big temple, Yoga Pith was built there.

That time, a Paramahamsa Vaishnava, Gaura Kishor Das Babaji Maharaj used to stay in Nabdvipa. He saw all the residents of Nabdvipa with transcendental eyes, considering them to be divine beings. He thus accepted madhukari from them, cooking everything in a rejected clay bowl. It is said that sometimes he would subsist on nothing but Ganges water and mud. Sometimes he would go for long periods without eating, chanting the Holy Names constantly. Srila Babaji Maharaj used to live beneath a broken boat continuously engaged in chanting with utmost renunciation. He set the standard for those in the renounced order who live the life of solitary worship, remaining completely independent of others. Gaura Kishor Das Babaji Maharaj would often go to Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakur’s place in Godrumdwipa, Svananda Sukhada Kunja, where he would listen to his readings of Srimad Bhagavatam and discuss Vaishnava theology.

In 1898 AD, Srila Bhakti Siddhanta Sarasvati Goswami Thakura got the first darsan of Srila Gaura Kishor Das Babaji Maharaj. Saraswati Thakura was enchanted and overcame with ecstasy by Babaji Maharaj’s heartfelt emotional kirtan, ‘kothāy go premamayi rādhe rādhe rādhe rādhe go, jaya rādhe rādhe’. Babaji Maharaj wrote that kirtan in the separation mood of Radharani. Prabhupad expressed his desire to take initiation from him. But Babaji Maharaja was an anchorite who had sworn not to take any disciples. He wanted to perform devotion in solitude without accepting any disciple. When someone accepts disciples, he has to think about the ultimate welfare of them. So he refused him by telling, “I do not give Mantra to anyone.” Many dignitaries used to come to have his darsan. Babaji Maharaj would never allow any materialistic persons to touch his feet. If they did so, he would make a show of anger, saying, “You will be doomed!” Most people were thus afraid to attempt it.

In winter season also, on the bank of Ganges, with only one lower cloth, he used to remain constantly engaged in chanting. Once a person came and gave him a quilt to protect himself from severe cold but when later he came again to see whether Babaji Maharaj used it or not, he saw it had been hung on the boat. With surprise, he asked Babaji Maharaj about it. In reply Babaji Maharaj told, “By just having the sight of the quilt, cold will run away.” He was such a personality. Even sitting in Nabdvip Dham he could understand what is going on in Vrindavan.

Prabhupad approached him many a times to take initiation from him but in spite of his repeated prayers, Babaji Maharaj was not ready to give Mantra to him. Babaji Maharaj told him, “I will ask permission from Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and if he agrees then only I shall give you Mantra.” After a few days when Prabhupad asked him again he said, “Oh! I forgot to ask.”

If we would have been there in Prabhupad’s position, we would have thought, “Oh! There are so many Gurus. I do not need a Guru like him. I will approach someone else.” A person like me would have become annoyed at such a situation. But our Prabhupad did not leave him.
He came back again after some days and asked Babaji Maharaj again, “Did you ask Mahaprabhu?”
Babaji Maharaj replied, “Yes. I asked Him.”
“What did He say?”
“Mahaprabhu told not to give Mantra to a proud person like you.”

After listening to Babaji Maharaj’s words Prabhupad’s face became pale and dark. Seeing Prabhupad’s unflinching conviction, Babaji Maharaj, who never allowed anyone to take his foot dust and if anyone tries to do so he who used to curse him saying, “Everything of yours will be destroyed”, took his foot-dust and smeared it all over the body of Prabhupad! He then told Prabhupad, “You are the only person who is competent to preach the message of Divine Love throughout the world.” He gave him Mantra and the power that was required to preach the doctrine of pure devotion. And with that power, Srila Prabhupad shook the whole world.

Thus, he was endowed with transcendental powers. He performed sacrifice of chanting hundred crores of Holy Names which he completed in nine years. He observed chaturmasya-vrat in Mayapur Dham. He did go-grass (eating like a cow without using his hands by serving the Prasadam on the floor) for these four months. He was an extraordinarily effulgent personality.

After he completed the sacrifice of chanting hundred crores of Holy Names, one night, he had a svapna-samadhi (dream-like vision) in which he saw all the members of the Pancha Tattva being led by Mahaprabhu in sankirtan, dancing and approaching toward the birthplace at the Yoga Pith in Mayapur, from the eastern side of its Natya-mandira. They were followed by the Six Goswamis and by Vaishnava Sarvabhauma Jagannath Das Babaji, Bhaktivinoda Thakura, Gaura Kishor Das Babaji Maharaj and other guruvarga members of the disciplic succession, all appearing in effulgent, divine forms. They ordered him to preach the doctrines of pure devotion to everyone, throughout the world.
“Mahaprabhu said, 'In every town and village of the earth, the chanting of My name will be propagated.”
Prabhupad said, “I do not have personnel, I do not have money for such a huge task, how is it possible for me to spread this message?”

They consoled Prabhupad, saying, “Why are you worrying? Get the task of preaching pure devotion underway. Preach Mahaprabhu’s message everywhere: spread service to Gaura-dhama (Mahaprabhu’s Abode), Gaura-nama (His Name), and Gaura-kama (His Desire or Work). All of us are at the ready to support you at every turn. We will help you at every moment in your efforts to preach pure devotional service. Countless people, unlimited wealth and extraordinary scholarship are all waiting for you to call for them. Whenever you need anything at all, it will come to you to be engaged in the service of the preaching mission. Simply go forward to preach the message of love of God, giving it your total effort. No worldly force will be able to disrupt this effort. We are with you always.”

From that day onward, he displayed an unbounded enthusiasm for the worldwide preaching of Mahaprabhu’s message. He first established Sri Chaitanya Math in Mayapur, then he went to Kolkata and stayed in a rental house at Ultadanga from where he had started his preaching activities. Srila Saraswati Prabhupad expanded his energy by transmitting his powers to his disciples and preached the message of pure devotion throughout the world.

At Ultadanga Road Srila Bhakti Siddhant Saraswati Goswami Thakur used to deliver sermons on Srimad Bhagavatam which is the quintessence of all Scriptures. Many people used to come to listen him. There, he spoke on one verse from 11th Canto for one full month.

lines: tūrṇaṁ yateta na pated anu-mṛtyu yāvan

blocks.text: “This human form of life is obtained after many, many births, and although it is not permanent, it can offer the highest benefits. Therefore a sober and intelligent man should immediately try to attain the highest benefit in life before another death occurs. One should avoid sense gratification, which is available in all circumstances.”

Even after commenting on this verse for one month, he was not satisfied and wanted to speak more about it! I heard from our Gurudev, when Srila Prabhupad was explaining this verse, one day, two students of Scottish Church College, Kolkata, who were going back home after attending their college, out of curiosity, came there. They got attracted to the divine form of Srila Prabhupad whose body was radiating a divine effulgence. They never saw such a personality in their life. Holding books in their hand, they sat down in the back and started listening to him attentively. Srila Prabhupad was telling, “The human birth is not only rare (durlabh), but extremely rare (sudurlabh).” He was explaining, “turnam yateta—one should start bhajan immediately, at the very moment, without any delay. Don’t spoil your time, a moment’s time should not be spent without serving Krishna. Any moment we may lose this human birth and there is no certainty that we shall again get this human birth. So, turnam yateta—immediately we should start bhajan. This human birth is very rare. After passing through 84 lakhs different species, a conditioned soul may get the birth as a human. In 84 lakh species, there are 900,000 kinds of aquatics, 2,000,000 kinds of trees and plants, 1,100,000 kinds of insects and reptiles, 1,000,000 kinds of birds, 3,000,000 kinds of four-legged beasts, and 400,000 kinds of human species. So human birth is rarest of the rare. Arthadam —in human life you can achieve the ultimate objective i.e. the Complete Reality. Until you achieve Complete Reality your wants will not be satisfied. Complete Reality is the Supreme Lord. We can achieve that Supreme Lord in human life. By attaining Him nothing remains to be attained.

lines: yasmin vijñate sarvam idam vijñatam bhavati
yasmin prapte sarvam idam praptam bhavati

blocks.text: Anityam—however this human life will not stay for long. Any moment it can go. Any moment we may lose this opportunity. Therefore, turnam yatet—IMMEDIATELY, AT THIS VERY MOMENT, without a moment’s delay we should start bhajan.” While speaking this Srila Prabhupad was looking at those students who came to attend the discourse. The students were surprised by this and began to wonder, “Why is he looking at us and speaking? We are not his disciples. Why is he looking at us while speaking?” They got scared and asked Prabhupad, “Swamiji, won’t you allow us to go back to our homes?” Srila Prabhupad said, “No, I will not allow you to go back to your houses.” The boys started to think, “Oh! What a problem. We have invited troubles by coming here. ” Now they thought, “How we can get ourselves free from this place? We have to go back to our house.”
They started to think how they could escape from him (Prabhupad) and said, “If our houses catch fire, won’t we go and extinguish the fire?”
Prabhupad said, “Let your houses burn. Even if your houses burn out, what have you people got to do with it?”
The students began to think, “What type of Saint is he?” Then they said, “If we do not extinguish the fire which caught our houses, then all the neighboring houses will burn out too.”

“Let the whole world burn, what do you lose? You are brahma bhuta—from the Lord; you are jagat bhuta—not of this world i.e. you are conscious entity, not matter. Consciousness begets matter and not vice versa. Body is not considered as a person, the soul is considered as a person, by the presence of which I have my existence. I am anu-saccidananda, so I do not want to die. Death is inevitable but still no one wants to die. Everyone wants to gain knowledge; everyone wants to get bliss. As I am anu-saccidananda,, I have desire for purna sat (Complete Existence), purna cit (Complete Knowledge), purna ananda (Compete Bliss). Being enveloped by the illusionary potency of the Supreme Lord, one considers himself a body. Now while returning home you may die. Even while walking in the streets you may die. Therefore, now when you have understood this, you should start bhajan immediately.” These boys could never go home back, they stayed in the Math for rest of their life.

This was the type of preaching activities done by Srila Prabhupad. We cannot even imagine what he did. We are ourselves so weak in our Bhajan. What will we preach to others? He was the personified energy of the Supreme Lord. Even if someone talked to him, they will be effected by his words. One of our elder God-brothers, namely Ashram Maharaj, who was previously called Krishna Prasad Prabhu, got the opportunity to talk with Srila Prabhupad. Once when Srila Prabhupad went for preaching in Assam, Krishna Prasad Prabhu who was at that time 10-12 years old, met him. Krishna Prasad Prabhu, who was then called Kamala Kanta Gosai, in his household life belonged to a family of Brahmins. One day when Srila Prabhupad was going to some place by traveling in a cart drawn by oxen, Kamala Kanta met him. Srila Prabhupad was sat on the cart, facing in the opposite direction. Srila Prabhupad asked him, “Who are you? What is your name? Where do you stay?” All these questions asked by Srila Prabhupad to Kamala Kanta are not Harikatha (discourses on the Supreme Lord). He simply saw Prabhupad who was talking to him. And simply by exchanging normal words with Srila Prabhupad, the material life of Kamala Kanta was destroyed.

After Srila Prabhupad left that place, Krishna Prasad Prabhu lost all his attachments to family life. After the departure of Srila Prabhupad, he took shelter at the lotus feet of our Gurudev. Later he became the in-charge of Mayapur Math. After Sannyas he came to be known as Ashram Maharaj. Srila Giri Maharaj, Srila Ashram Maharaj and myself took Sannyas at the same time. So, in this manner the grace incarnate form of the Supreme Lord can bestow his grace only by means of speaking to someone. Just as the rays of the Sun fall in both clean and dirty places, similarly the grace of the Supreme Lord comes on all living entities. Whoever comes in front of the grace-incarnate-form of the Lord (shuddha-bhakta), gets his grace and feels a sense of vibration. Only by this feeling of vibration, one can understand that something has happened to him. So Kamala Kanta Gosai also changed by merely exchanging words with Srila Prabhupad who is a personal associate of the Supreme Lord.
After seeing our Gurudev, he left family life. Though Srila Prabhupad left, he got the grace of our Gurudev.

So on today’s Tithi, we should perform Vyasa Puja of Srila Prabhupad who was a powerful personal associate of the Lord. What is the meaning of Vyasa Puja? There is a special injunction in the scriptures that one should perform worship of one’s Gurudev on his advent. We perform worship of Srila Vedavyas Muni, who is the spiritual master for all of us, in the month of Asadha, on the occasion of Guru-purnima. This worship is called ‘Vyasa Puja’ which is performed by all sorts of people belonging to different schools of thoughts namely the karmis (fruitive workers), jnanis (aspirants for liberation), yogis (performers of yoga for attaining eight-fold mystic perfections), the worshipers of various demigods etc. Even those who utter, “aham brahmashmi—“I am Brahman myself” also perform Guru Puja.

Sripad Shankaracharya has said-“adwaitam triso….adwaitam Gurunas..” It means, “ I am the Lord myself for all the three worlds, but I am not non-different with my Gurudev.” Shankaracharya had himself said that one should serve his Gurudev. Shankaracharya had to work very hard to remove nastikyavad—disbelief in the existence of the Supreme Lord preached by the Buddhists. He rejected nirvana and re-established the foundation of the Vedas by preaching brahma-nirvana. In this way he re-established the foundation of Sanatan Dharma once again. He personally worshiped the Supreme Lord, bhaja govindam, bhaja govindam, bhaja govindam, mudha mate—“Oh ignorant people, you should definitely worship Govinda. He destroyed all the false philosophies regarding nastikyavad and re-establishing the Vedic religion. One can get the service of the Supreme Lord only by serving his Gurudev. If one thinks oneself to be Guru, then whom shall he render service? Should I serve myself? It is a wrong concept.”

Srila Prabhupad had performed worship of his Gurudev on his appearance day. By seeing his conduct all his disciples all over the world started performing his worship on his advent. Now, a question may arise, “Why should one perform Guru Puja?”

If we go to the eleventh Canto of Srimad Bhagavatam we will find Nimi-Nava-Yogendra samvad (conversation between King Nimi and the nine Yogendras). These nine Yogendras were the youngest among all the sons of Rishabhadeva. These nine Yogendras arrived at the place of sacrifice of the King of Videha namely Nimi.
King Nimi worshiped them after their arrival and told them, “On seeing you all, it seems that you people are the personal associates of the Supreme Lord Madhusudana Himself.”

Nimi Maharaj continued, “Though I have not invited you all, but still you all have come.” (Guruji having light conversation, “This Nava-Yogendra samvad is a long topic. If I start it now then all of you will not have the time to have Prasadam. So I will not start reading it now” (laughter from audience). “So I will read quickly and in brief.”)
There is a verse which says,

“The human birth is very rare but more than it, the audience (darshan) of a pure devotee of the Supreme Lord is rare.”
So Maharaj Nimi told the Nava-Yogendras, “I have got the darshan of you all, such fortune is extremely rare. I have got a question for you all,

“O Saints! I am a dullard having attachment to this body and to persons related to this body. I have no control over senses. It is impossible for me to rescue myself from the clutches of the deluding external potency of the Lord having three primal qualities of sattva, rajah and tamah, i.e., preserving, creating and destroying qualities. Birth, existence and death are caused by the deluding force of the Lord's external potency. We suffer at the time of birth and death as well as during existence. As long as we live in this world, we suffer threefold afflictions—(i) affliction caused by physical ailments and mental sufferings such as grief due to the separation from near and dear ones; (ii) affliction caused by other living beings; (iii) affliction caused by demigods, i.e., natural calamities—earthquakes, inundation, famine, epidemics, drought, deluge, etc. Kindly show me the simple path to get deliverance from the forest fire of worldly affliction.”
Prabuddha Muni, one of the nine saints, replied,

“A man starts a profession or business, weds or does not wed with the sole purpose of removing affliction and getting happiness. When he finds that he is unable to remove affliction and get happiness by his own effort, he marries and becomes two to try jointly to remove affliction and get happiness. Even then when he is unsuccessful he begets children and increases the number of family members, to try with joint efforts to attain the objective. But, O Videha Raj Nimi! Behold! The result is just the reverse, neither he can remove affliction nor he can get happiness.”

When Srila Prabhupad was in Sri Mayapur at the time of the British regime, all the queens of the kings of Jaipur and Tripura would come to see this holy city. One of the queens of Jaipur wanted to speak privately with Prabhupad, who then requested all persons to leave. "Swamiji," she said, "I am most unfortunate! Although I am married, I am not permitted any connection with my husband or my family. I am kept in a restricted place and cannot go anywhere. For one year I have been so dissatisfied. I want to commit suicide, but suicide is a great sin. I am so unfortunate that even the beggar or a pauper is happier than I! Please bless me that I should never be born in a royal family again!" Gurudev was astounded!

So, the conclusion is that it is not necessary that one will become happy if he possesses wealth. Both rich persons as well as poor persons are not happy. Those who are married are not happy and those who are not married like myself are also not happy. I used to think that those who are married are happy.

It is said, ‘Dilli ka laddu jo khaya vo pastaya, jo nahi khaya vo bhi pastaya’, “Those who have eaten laddu, a kind of sweet, manufactured in Delhi have repented, and those who have not eaten also regretted.” Those who are married tell me, “Swamiji, I have done a big mistake.” Our condition is like a person who is deluded to mistake a bear for a blanket. By mistaking a bear for a blanket, we catch hold of it and then the bear will also catch us in return. By our own efforts we will not be able to free ourselves from the bear. Only a personal associate of the Supreme Lord will be able to free us from the grip of the bear. In this way this material life is like a bear. If we enter into its captivity, we will no longer be able to come out of it.
Once a person came to our Kolkata Math. He was about fifty years old. He came and told me, “I have renounced family life. I want to stay in this Math and perform bhajan.”
I told him, “It seems that you have married. You have a wife and children.” He replied in affirmation. I told him, “Then how will you stay here by leaving all of them?”
“You people have left your family lives and are performing bhajan by staying in the Math. Won’t you allow me to do the same?”
“Yes, I have no problem. But your family members will not allow you to stay here and perform bhajan.”
“Let them come.”
“Okay, stay here and do bhajan.”
After a few days his wife started searching for him throughout Kolkata. And while searching, she came to our Math and at that time I was stepping down the stairs with that person.
She saw him and asked him, “You have come here?”
“I have come here for performing bhajan. I have done many mistakes. Now I do not want to go back to material life any more. I want to perform bhajan.”
She shouted, “You did not remember this when you married me? Now, you are putting all responsibilities on me and enjoying here!! Just come with me.” She forcibly took him away.
So, it is not so easy to get out once one gets entangled in this material life. So we get deluded to think that we will become happy if we get a beautiful wife, a son, a daughter etc. etc.

The Nava Yogendras said, “Hey Videha Raj Nimi, by such activities neither can anyone remove his unhappiness nor can one attain bliss.” The only way to attain bliss is to take absolute shelter of a Guru who is both well-versed in scriptures and has got practical realization of Divinity.

If a person is diseased can he cure himself? No, he has to go to an expert doctor for treatment. There are so many doctors who are specialized in various fields of medical science. We go to them for treatment of our worldly diseases. Similarly, for treatment of the disease of worldly maladies, namely cycles of births, deaths and three-fold afflictions, one should approach an expert spiritual doctor who will only be a real saint, a personal representative of the Lord. It is not so easy to get such a Sad-Guru, a bona fide Guru. When you will seek qualities you will have to sacrifice quantity and vice versa.
Mahadeva has said to Parvati Devi,
“There are so many Gurus who are eager to snatch money from their disciples. But one can rarely get a bona fide Guru who can snatch the afflictions of his disciples.”

So, it is said in the scriptures that one can achieve the Supreme Lord (Param Purush) only after surrendering at the lotus feet of the Acharya (bona fide representative of the Lord). One cannot achieve Him by means of his own efforts. It is not so easy to cross over this ocean of material world. One can cross over this material world only by getting the grace of a bona fide Guru after surrendering at his lotus feet. Even in Gita, Sri Krishna has mentioned that one should surrender to tattva-darshi , a bona fide representative of the Lord who has practical knowledge about the Lord.
So, Guru Puja (worship of one’s Gurudev) means one has to act as per the desire of his Gurudev.

Some Divine sayings of Srila Prabhupad, “Wherever there is Harikatha, all the Holy places reside there.” The significance of this above saying is, wherever the pure devotees of the Lord, who have sacrificed their lives for Him, are speaking about the Lord only for His satisfaction, all the holy places reside there.

Another saying, “Without criticizing the faults of others, one should try to rectify oneself.” We have the tendency to see faults in others. But such acts are futile. Both good and bad qualities will be present in human beings. For this reason try to find good qualities in others and faults in yourself. Only then will there be rectification. For this reason, instead of trying to find faults in others, one should endeavor only to rectify his own nature. One can only teach others by means of his own example. For this reason one should try to correct oneself and only then others may learn from him.

Another saying, “Other than those who are performing Hari-bhajan all are ignorant and are atma-ghati—destroyer of their self.” So, the one who has left worshiping the Supreme Lord is an ignorant being and is committing suicide. All of us have originated from the Lord, we are within Him, by Him and so we should remain for Him. The one who does not remain for the Supreme Lord, he has committed suicide. So if one really wants to do Guru Puja, he has to follow his instructions. It will not be sufficient to pay only floral tributes without following his instructions. Here only a few instructions are given, but there is a book which contains all his instructions. One should go through them and follow those instructions. One can get deliverance from the bondage of Maya only by listening to Harikatha, discourses on the Supreme Lord, from the lotus lips of Gurudev. A professional speaker who speaks Harikatha for getting money has the goal of earning money. One will not get any benefit by hearing Harikatha from such a speaker. Maya will immediately leave a person if he hears Harikatha from a real saint whose life is only dedicated to the Supreme Lord. For this reason one should hear Harikatha from such a person. We give excuses like drowsiness while hearing Harikatha. So, should one only sleep instead of attending Harikatha? No, this is not correct. If one keeps on speaking about Hari and leaves his body, then he will go to Hari after leaving his body.

Even if one faces hundreds of troubles, hundreds of oppressions from others, he should not stop his bhajan. When one tries to make an instrument (Katari) out of iron, he has to first heat it to make it red-hot. After that one has to beat it continuously with a hammer. After that there are some other processes like twisting etc that are to be done on that iron to shape it and make it to the desired instrument. Similarly when one has to go back to the Supreme Lord, the Lord will make him go through tribulations and abuses from people all over the world. After getting such repeated tribulations when one will develop the qualities of tolerance and forgiveness, the Lord will say, “Now you are qualified to enter My abode.” For this reason, even if one gets hundreds of abuses, hundreds of troubles and hundreds of tribulations and oppressions one should never leave Hari-bhajan.
Vancha-kalpataru…

articles.title: Glories of Srila Saraswati Thakur and His Last Instructions
articles.author: Sreela Bhakti Ballabh Tirtha Goswami Maharaj
articles.excerpt: This is a conversation of a few foreign devotees with Srila Gurudev in which he is requested to speak about Srila Saraswati Prabhupad and his teachings. Srila Gurudev sings the glories of Srila Prabhupad and gives the gist of his instructions. In between, Srila Gurudev has some light and sweet conversation with them which shows how much affection he has for everyone.

blocks.text: Question: What was Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati Thakur’s vision of preaching in European countries?

Gurudev: Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati Thakur and Bhaktivinod Thakur are not ordinary human beings. They are transcendental realized persons. They are the personal associates of Supreme Lord Sri Krishna. So, a conditioned soul, by his finite intellect, finite mental capacity, all these temporary sense organs cannot enter into that (spiritual realm). That is the difficulty, serious difficulty. But when we think that we can judge them then everything is lost. Any time when you think that you have got this sort of capacity to understand them and we can say that they are good or bad persons, then your spiritual amelioration (is)stopped. Everything descends from Supreme Lord. There should be absolute complete surrender, unconditional surrender. Without that we cannot enter into the spiritual realm.

After the disappearance of Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and His personal associates like the six Goswamis, Srinivas Acharya, Narottam Thakur, Shyamanand Prabhu and others, there came a dark age. Why was that? All the books were there, all scriptures were there; Chaitanya Bhagwat, Chaitanya Charitamrita were there, but so many pseudo sects cropped up that time. They claimed that they were actually preaching the message of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, but they were doing just the opposite. Totaram Das Babaji Maharaj named thirteen such pseudo sects:

lines: āul, bāul, kartābhajā, neṛā, daraveśa, sain
totā kahe ei teror saṅga nāhi kari

blocks.text: The number that time was 13, but now it may be 40-50. It increased. Why? Chaitanya Mahaprabhu saw that worldly people are unable to understand His teachings. He thought, “How can I give eternal benefit to them? I have to send My own persons from here. These conditioned souls, by their intellect, they are misinterpreting My teachings and saying just the opposite.”

So He sent Bhaktivinod Thakur and by accepting Bhaktivinod Thakur and Bhagwati Devi, Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati Thakur appeared in Purushottam Dham. It is written in Padma Purana, hy utkale purushottamat—the message of pure devotion to Sri Krishna would get spread throughout the world from Jagannāth Purī. In this Kali-yuga, pure devotion would get spread over through a personal associate of Supreme Lord; who is he? Our Param Gurudev, after whose appearance in Purushottam Dham, Krishna-bhakti got spread over throughout the world.

(Guruji is having some light conversion with devotees for about a minute. He is showing affection to the child of the devotee who came to have his darshan. Guruji, referring to the age of the child, says, “This age is very good. They do not know anything. This is pure age. This purity should be retained throughout the life. Then it is possible to get God. It is not very difficult to get God. Only you should give up deceitfulness. One should be simple hearted.)

You want to hear from me but I do not have complete surrender to Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati Thakur or to his another extended form, our Gurudev. How can I speak? Yet, it is the standing order of our Gurudev that wherever you go you should repeat whatever you have heard from the lotus lips of your Guru, Guruvarga and Vaishnavas for your own spiritual benefit. Benefit yourself, automatically others will get benefitted.

Bhaktisiddhanta Saraswati Thakur came to Bagh Bazar Gaudiya Math, Kolkata from the Chatak Parvat, Purushottam Dham. He was playing the pastimes of being very sick. So, all were very much perturbed. He called all the devotees, they came. Household devotees and everyone who had the desire to hear from him had come. And addressing them he said in Bengali, “aapnara sakaleyi ek advaya-gyaner aprakrit indriya triptir uddesye ashraya vigraher aanugatye mile mise thakaben—You, one and all, should satisfy the transcendental sense organs of advaya-gyan. Who is advaya-gyan?
(Krishna is the non-dual Absolute Truth, the Supreme Lord. Although, He is one, He maintains different personal expansions and energies for His pastimes.)

Advaya-jñāna is both the substance (the Lord) and His potency. Absolute spiritual potency is Radharani. So, Advaya-jñāna means RadhaKrishna. You have to satisfy the transcendental sense organs, not these mundane non-eternal material sense organs. This body is non-eternal. Sense organs are also non-eternal. When you leave this body, you lose your sense organs also. You lose the capacity of sense organs to get their objects; you cannot see, hear or touch. When the body perishes, sense organs also perish. Whatever you feel through these non-eternal sense organs is also non-eternal. It is very easy to understand. There is no complication. You think, ‘I am the enjoyer, master of this world’, but everything is non-eternal. The eternal truth is beyond the comprehension of our mundane sense organs, even the subtle sense organs; mind and intellect.

Krishna has said in Gita, mind, intelligence and perverted ego are the outcome of His material energy (apara-prakriti) and not the spiritual energy. And beyond that apara-prakriti, there exist His superior potency, the marginal potency—tatastha-shakti also called para potency. Jiva is the outcome of para potency. In their real self they are sat-chid-anand. They are conscious entities; nobody can destroy them. They exist eternally but there are minutest spiritual particle. Jivas are the part of the potency, not the part of the substance. Substance is God, Bhagavan—who possesses all opulences in totality. There are infinite opulences amongst which six opulences are main. One who possesses all the opulences in full is called God. All the jivas are the outcome of the potency of God, not the part or manifestation of Supreme Lord. Supreme Lord has got many manifestations. Supreme Lord is one but He can appear in various forms. Ontologically, all His manifestations are same but if you think in reference to the delightful relations, then the highest is Sri Krishna. All kinds of delightful relations are there in Krishna. Chaitanya Mahaprabhu taught us that you can worship Narayan, Varaha Bhagwan or any other form of Lord but you will attain the highest bliss by worshipping Nandnandan Sri Krishna only. All sorts of delightful relations exist in Him.

In Brahma's one day, Nandanandana Sri Krishna appears once only. It is difficult to calculate the time duration of one day of Brahma. It comprises of 14 Manvantaras. Each Manvantaras has 71 Chatur-yuga (four ages). And there are 4 ages—Satyayug, Treta, Dwapar and Kali. We are in the 28th Chatur-yuga of Vaivasvata Manvantara. Kali-yuga has the duration of 4,32,000 years. Dwapar is double of Kali-yuga, Treta-yuga is triple of Kali-yuga and Satya-yuga is four times of span of Kali-yuga. Then 43, 20,000 years is one Chatur-yuga. 71 such Chatur-yuga is the span of life of one Manu. And the life span of 14 such Manus is Brahma’s one day. Currently, we are in the 7th Manvantara. In this Dwapara-yuga Nandanandan Krishna has appeared. He performed His pastimes with His own personal associates. He did not give this sweet love to anybody. But in this Kali-yuga, He appeared taking the form and complexion of Radharani as Gauranga to taste his own sweetness as well as to give the highest Divine Love to all. So it is His standing order to His personal associates, “You have to inform this to all corners of the world”.

Previously they did not go outside India. Because of the order of Supreme Lord, “You should give this to all. You should not deprive them”, they went outside India and propagated His message. Our Puri Goswami Maharaj repeatedly asked me to go. What benefit shall I get by going there? But he ordered me three times. Then, he wrote a letter to me and then I decided to go. I asked him, “Will you take my responsibility if I have a spiritual fall by going outside India? So much opulence and attractive things are there. I shall be indebted to my parents and others. Will you please take my responsibility?”

Then he said, “Your Gurudev will take your responsibility. You should go.” Vaishnavas speak like this. They are always humble. They do not express any kind of vanity. When there is vanity everything is lost. Target should be one—to satisfy Supreme Lord Krishna. He has transcendental sense organs. And to satisfy His absolute counterpart Radharani. That should be the target. He is the owner and the master.
(I am the only enjoyer and master of all sacrifices. Therefore, those who do not recognize My true transcendental nature fall down.)

We are to be enjoyed by Him. We are to be subdued by Him. My potency remains for me. His potency should remain for Him. Our bodies (gross and subtle) are the outcome of His potency. He is the possessor of all the potency. His potency should remain Him. So, our body, sense organs and everything should be engaged for His service. That should be natural. Our subtle body also called astral body made up of mind, intellect and ego should be engaged for His service. Our real self, the soul, is the product of His para potency (marginal potency). So, He is the master of soul, subtle body and gross body, everything. If we do not get that realization of our natural relation with Supreme Lord then how can we proceed? Our target should be one—the satisfaction of Supreme Lord and that one should do by taking shelter of His absolute counterpart Gurudev. Gurudev is ashraye vigraha—Predominated Absolute. We should submit to him and remain unitedly. If there is any other desire except this then, we cannot remain united. There will be quarrel. This world is the prison house and we all have come here because of our desires for enjoyment. Because of our enjoying tendencies we fight with each other. In family, society, nation, everywhere there is fight. The root cause of our ignorance is the misconception of self—we think that I am this body. We consider the body to be everything and always think about bodily interests. We think, “I shall run after all these non-eternal things”. If anybody gets something that I do not get then I become furious and fight with him. The world is a forest fire.

Srila Prabhupad instructs, “You all should remain unitedly”. Merely staying in Math will not bestow upon actual benefit. If you remain here morphologically, externally, without understanding the ontological aspect then you will not get any benefit. By seeing the outward wealth etc., for getting some mundane benefit if you enter into Math then, you are deceiving yourself and others as you have not got contact with the ontological aspect.

Srila Prabhupad said, “I do not stay in Kolikata (Kolkata)”. Koli (or Kali) means black age, full of quarrel and all abominable things. That time he was in Kolkata only at Bagh Bazar Gaudiya Math but he said, “I do not stay in this Kali’s place. Because my object of worship RadhaKrishna reside here; this is transcendental realm—Vrindavan. This Gaudiya Math is not the place of Kali; it is not made up of earth, water, fire, air, sky etc.”

With this physical body, we cannot enter in Navadwipa Dham, we cannot enter in Vrindavan Dham. Dham appears in this world. If you submit, then by His grace you can enter. His grace spiritual potency, Radharani and Her extended forms will come to you. If you submit to them then the eternal nature of the real self will be awakened and you will get causeless devotion to Him and you will cry for Him. You will not cry for kanik, kamini and pratishtha—money, woman and fame. When causeless devotion will awaken, you will run towards Supreme Lord as iron runs towards the magnet. Magnet attracts iron naturally. Krishna is like magnet. Krishna is All Attractive. We are to be attracted by Him. But we do not feel that attraction so it is not true that He is All Attractive. It is not like that. When there is rust on the iron, it does not get attracted by Magnet.

When you remove rust then iron will run towards the magnet. There is rust in your own self; he is being enveloped by the illusory energy. All these evil desires have spoiled your mind; have made your mind impure. You have to remove that rust by the company of actual sadhu. Sadhu may be of different stages. If you have company of kanishtha (preliminary stage) that is also beneficial. But if you associate with non-devotees then you will not get anything. By association of sadhus our mind will be changed.

(Guruji is asking the devotees, “Have you taken Prasad. You have to be careful when you take Prasad because there is atom bomb inside it. What is that atom bomb?” Devotees, “Chili!!” Guruji, “Yes, chili is there inside. Even if you boil it, it has so much tremendous power inside which can harm you. So you should be very careful while taking Prasad as you are not accustomed to take it. It can cause some defect in your stomach.” Gurudev then continues some light conversion with devotees).
(Guruji then continues to speak about the last instructions of Srila Prabhupad)

Don't think about the comforts of the body, somehow you take something. Don’t give too much importance to physical comforts, then you will get devotion. Our shad Goswamis used to live under tree, they were very rich; Sanatan Goswami was prime minister; Raghunath Das goswami was a son of a very rich person. Do not give up shravan-kirtan—chanting and hearing. Majority of the people are not following this, don’t be disappointed. In spite of hundreds of scolding and reproach, hundreds of humiliation and hundreds of insults don't give up RadhaKrishna bhajan.

articles.title: A Lecture by Srila Prabhupad on His Vyasa Puja
articles.author: Sreemad Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati Goswami Thakura Prabhupad
articles.excerpt: Sri Guru’s lotus feet are eternal. May I never undergo an interruption of relationship with his lotus feet, even for a single moment. May I be never loosened, even for a moment, from the bond that unites me to his lotus feet. May I never for a moment quit my hold of his lotus feet by being tempted by any fascination of this world. May I never be deprived of His lotus feet by listening to the advice of any other, worthless person.

lines: caksur-unmilitam yena tasmai sri guruve namah

blocks.text: ["Obeisances to Sri Gurudeva who has opened our sealed eyes, blinded by the darkness of ignorance, with the spike of the collyrium of knowledge."]

Today is the day of the worship of Sri Guru, and I have come here today for this purpose. I am a person blinded by ignorance. Ignorance is an object resembling darkness. I am the servant of Vishnu – I have no other function except the service of Vishnu – this mode of thought is being obstructed by the darkness of nescience. I have become blind for the present. Absence of light is darkness; absence of knowledge is ignorance. The only knowledge is the darling of Nanda, who is replete with all knowledge. I, who am averse to the service of the darling of Nanda, am blind.

Darkness assuming form envelopes my eyes. It is for this reason that my function of vision is inoperative, and that there has appeared in me the tendency towards various other activities. By means of my senses – namely, hands, feet, eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin – I am engaged in a variety of work. Because of this, a multitude of diverse dangers confront me. By attempting to walk with these feet I often stumble and fall. By trying to discuss with this mind, I am invoking manifold evil by not being able to understand the real subject of knowledge.

In such an hour of peril, Sri Guru, being moved to pity, manifested in this world. This has been done in order that he may impart to me the knowledge that "You are the servant of the darling of Nanda," and to dispel the darkness of ignorance.

My loss of sense of duty has led me to embark on the enjoyment of worldly objects, and to think such enjoyment is my duty. With this eye I see what is not my duty to see. I see only the bondage that obstructs me from my vision of He whom I ought to see by all means. By being deprived of His sight, I see only this bondage of material enjoyment.

The lotus feet of Sri Guru have imparted to me the light of spiritual knowledge, by removing that bondage of my eyes. Moving aside the bondage of my wrapped eyes and making the lids of my eyes open slightly, Gurudeva instructed me, saying, "Open your eyes a little and see." All these days I had been thinking that I can see by keeping my eyes closed.

For this reason I am performing the duty of offering obeisances to the lotus feet of Sri Guru, by giving up my worldly vanity. This is the first object of offering my worship. To give up the vanity that thinks "I see," "I enjoy," is called "offering obeisances." While I was cherishing the wicked notion that I am the master, Sri Guru opened my eyes and removed my misjudging judgment. I was following the blind, under the lead of the knowledge of other objects. The lotus feet of Sri Guru made me realize that it is my duty not to follow the blind.

I did not possess that judgment of worshipping the lotus feet of Sri Guru for many years. The service of Sri Guru is verily my only duty, the function of the principle of my individual self. This also I have been enabled to understand only by his grace. After obtaining the sight of the lotus feet of Sri Guru, I have no longer such judgment that I have any other function except serving the feet of Sri Guru.

By his mercy, that dearest servant of the Supreme Lord, in order to rescue me from the clutches of worldly vanity, made me cognizant of the service of the darling of Nanda. It was only at that moment that I could realize that there is no other function of the jiva's own self. There is no other blessing except the endeavor to please the senses of the darling of Nanda. He alone is both the only mode and the only goal of all my activities. Sri Guru is His most beloved.

The service to the lotus feet of Sri Guru cannot be performed by an unskilled person like me, by any of the instruments such as body, mind and speech. If Sri Guru infuses in me the power, or looks upon me with approval, then I can gain his favor, and I can then obtain the fitness for serving him.

I could understand the subject of the summum bonum only on the day Sri Guru placed his feet, which are obtainable with difficulty even by the gods, on the head of an unworthy person like myse lf and baptized me with their dust. I then submitted to them the auspicious wish that I might be a fit recipient of the potency that is wielded by them.

In my vanity I could not fancy that the lotus feet of Sri Guru could be really so great. But if I narrate to you the good fortune attained by them, this may be conducive to the worship of Sri Guru by yourselves also.

Srila Krishnadasa Kaviraja Gosvami has prayed, "I am most unworthy. I am more sinful than Jagai and Madhai; more insignificant than the maggot germinating in filth. The goodness of the person who even chances to hear my name, wears off. He who even utters my name reaps sin. Who is there in this world to have mercy on me, with the single exception of Sri Nityananda Prabhu?"*[See Endnote 1]

I have no resources to show my gratitude towards one who has acted the part of the most merciful of all persons, for the purpose of conferring on such an unworthy person the gift of fitness. It is not possible for me to repay his kindness in any way. Sri Guru is the counterpart of Godhead – possessing a singleness of purpose to serve Godhead. Every act of his is the highest ideal of the service of Godhead. As long as this vision suffers any impediment, the scales have not fallen from my eyes.

Unless we obtain the grace, unless we gain spiritual enlightenment, we cannot realize the greatness of his lotus feet. When I set myself to discourse regarding Sri Gurudeva, I find that he manifests himself in this world for the establishment of the heart's desire of Sri Chaitanya, for rousing me into the waking state. Our previous acarya Thakura Narottama has revealed this:
sri chaitanya mano' bhistam stapitam yena bhutale
svayam rupah kada mahyam dadati sva-padantikam
"Oh, when will Sri Rupa himself, by whom the heart's desire of Sri Chaitanya has been substantiated in this world, vouchsafe me the close proximity of his own feet?"

After I had the good fortune of obtaining the sight of the lotus feet of Sri Guru, I had the opportunity of discoursing about these words of the best of teachers, Thakura Narottama. The lotus feet of Sri Guru manifest in this world for establishing the heart's desire of Sri Chaitanya.

What is the nature of the heart of Sri Chaitanya? Sri Chaitanyadeva had said, "The hearts of other persons are their minds. My mind is Vrindavana. I deem My mind and the divine woodland where Krishna loves to stroll as the same."

The holy Vrindavana is really the heart of Sri Gaurasundara. Only those who are saved from the clutches of evil can realize the nature of Sri Vrindavana. The word "abhista" in the verse of Thakura Narottama means literally "to desire in every way". He is referring to that which is desired by Chaitanya in every way, that which Chaitanya wills, and the teaching that He imparts for making the unconscious conscious. He prays, "When will Sri Rupa Gosvami Prabhupada, who has established this teaching of Chaitanya in this world, place me in the close proximity of his lotus feet for the same service of the Lord?" The word "svayam rupa" may also mean "the personal form of the divinity, the darling of Nanda". In that case he prays, "When will Sri Krishnacandra, drawing my soul to His, take me to the proximity of His lotus feet?"

In Sri Krishna's personal form is concentrated the principles of real existence, consciousness and bliss. With this bag of bone and muscle, this carcass of flesh and blood which has been born of parents for the purpose of suffering pain, for undergoing the threefold-misery in the prison of this world, for my aversion to Krishna – with this bundle of flesh and bones one cannot go to His presence.

Nor is it possible to approach the proximity of the feet of the personal divinity with the current of mental thought engrossed in external objects of sensuous perception, in which there is consciousness of any other object than the darling of Nanda. When the external objects of this world – house, body, air, fruits and flowers, this whole world – tell me, "Master, we wish to serve you," then I think, "Very well, let me be the lord of these."

The air-god is an object of my highest worship. Inhaling him with my nose and fancying him to be an object for ministering to my pleasure, I try to absorb him into my lungs. Why? In order to maintain my life, I have conceived the desire of becoming the lord pf my senses. I cannot understand that this eye is preventing me from seeing the unique and incomparable beauty of the darling of Nanda by holding external color and form; nor that the external sound is the obstacle of my catching the sound of Krishna's flute.

I am not able to find the strength to surmount this obstacle until Sri Guru, full of en dless mercy, manifests himself to me. I have been unable to feel any liking for the lotus feet of Sri Chaitanya, the darling of Sri Nanda, and for the feet of Sri Rupa Gosvami – Sri Rupa Manjari – whose endeavors are fast bound to the lotus feet of Sri Chaitanya. Alas! Indeed, where is another person whose fate is as blasted as mine?

Others work towards establishing the tidings of aversion to the darling of Nanda in this wicked world. But Sri Guru, the best beloved of Sri Chaitanya, out of mercy, is trying to establish Sri Chaitanya in my heart. When will the lotus feet of Sri Guru graciously allot me a place in their close proximity? When will Sri Guru make me enter the community of the followers of Rupa? When will the Vaishnavas, making me bathe in the shower of the dust of their feet, accept me as their servant? When shall I be able to behold that blessing, by bathing in the particles of feet-dust of the Vaishnavas – that blessing by which I shall be able to obtain the mercy of that beauteous person Himself? Sri Baladeva Nityananda, who is the manifestation of Godhead's own Self, is Himself endeavoring to serve Krishna by cherishing that self-conception.

There can be no service of Gaura if one is enveloped by the faculty of aversion. Sri Guru is that very person who, focusing in himself the manifestation of Krishna's own transcendental form, is engaged in establishing the heart's desire of Sri Chaitanya in this world.

Sri Krishna, Brahma, Narada, Vyasa, Madhva, Padmanabha, Nrhari, Madhava, Aksobhya, Jayatirtha, Jnanasindhu, Dayanidhi, Vidyanidhi, Rajendra, Jayadharma, Purusottama, Vyasatirtha, Laksmipati, Madhavendra, Isvara, Advaita, Nityananda, Isvara's "disciple" Sri Chaitanya – this is the successive order of preceptors. Sri Krishna has established the preceptorial order of this world. When will Krishna, drawing me into Himself, make me and object of His grace?

There is no function or object of endeavor for the individual soul, other than the service of Sri Radha-Govinda. I have observed this judgment and conduct only by the mercy of my Sri Guru. The worship of other gods, and so on, is also not the object of the endeavor of the individual soul.

The heart's desire of Sri Chaitanya alone is also the limit of the desire of the individual soul. Words on any other subject are only a contrivance for the production of evil. This teaching also has been imparted by Sri Guru alone. Sri Guru is serving the darling son of Nanda at all times, by all senses, in every way. There is no other function of Sri Guru even for the space of a single moment, than such service. Unless we behold this, we do not really accept the protecting guidance of Sri Guru.

The darling son of Nanda, who is the sole object of worship by means of His centripetal attraction, has kept the attracted so effectively drawn towards Him that they do not experience any other desire. Such service is the only natural function of the soul. We, who are empowered by the limiting energy (maya), by the idea that we are not predominated parts of the divinity, are being engrossed by His deluding external power.

What endless variety of pretenses have been put before us by the deluding energy in order to seduce us to the ambition of lording it over the material world, to impress on us that we have need of this connection with matter! The deluding energy has been appearing before us like a harlequin wearing a variety of masks.

We belong to the class of servants, as particles of the predominated energy of Godhead. We are not the concentrated or plenary forms of the predominated power. We shall lapse into the worship of the form of the false ego if we cherish the offensive desire of masquerading as the holy concentrated forms of power, by giving up the inclination of serving Godhead by submission to the true concentrated personalities of power.

We are dis-associable particles. If we are not separable, how else can we learn to be averse to Sri Hari? These manifold misunderstandings have appeared in me by reason of my cherishing the idea that Sri Guru, the best beloved of the bestower of freedom from ignorance, has no relationship of kindred with me. I think that these misunderstandings are my enemies.

Those who help me towards the aptitude for service of Krishna are my only friends. Those who help me augment my aversion to Krishna are my most deadly enemies. Forgetting this judgment, I become busy with activities for procuring vegetables, fish, fuel, and so on, for the maintenance and nourishment of those kindred of mine who are averse to Krishna. Forgetfulness of the service of the lotus feet of Sri Guru, the best beloved of the bestower of freedom from worldly bondage, is the cause of this.

Those who are comparatively less fortunate maintain that the worship of Sita-Rama is the best of all. Those who are less fortunate than even these, regard the worship of Sri Sri Lakshmi-Narayana and the fourfold enveloping expansions (vyuha) as the highest form of worship. Those wretched who are wholly devoid of any such thing as good fortune, get enveloped in abstract indefinite thinking and, ignoring even the unknowable existence of the spiritual, regard the dogma of the void as the highest of all. There are also a few who propound the hypothetical views of skepticism and agnosticism. In this manner one gets anxious to secede from the lotus feet of Sri Guru, in that proportion that his aversion to Krishna increases.

One welcomes as his guru that degree of aversion to Krishna which happens to characterize himself. By this process, the individual soul attains to diverse conditions ranging from that of contracted consciousness to that of a stone. Sri Guru is engaged in establishing the heart's desire of Sri Chaitanya as soon as such misfortune overtakes us. I feel no hankering for the sight of the beauty of the lotus feet of Sri Guru who is so merciful. My thoughts wander away in all directions, in search of sensuous gratification, seeking how the belly may be well filled, how it may be possible to enjoy the world in an effective manner, how bodily ailments may be cured, how physical health may be maintained, and so on, and so on.

The words of Sri Gaurasundara, those words that Sri Guru always repeats to us, declare that in the case of a person who does not want any personal advantage, who is inclined to serve Godhead, who is anxious to get across the ocean of the world to the further shore of the spiritual realm, for such a person to appreciate worldliness and women is, alas, more harmful than swallowing poison.

When Sri Guru bestows on us the mantra (which relieves one from the mental platform), in which he has been instructed by the Supreme Lord's own, it is only then that we realize the fact that the service of the lotus feet of Sri Guru is the only cause of all well-being.

For the present I will serve Sri Guru starting from the commencement of every year to its close, throughout the whole of the year. I will serve him in future births. If, as the result of my service I attain the state of liberated life someday, I will serve the son of Sri Nanda by continuing to be the recipient of the lotus feet of Sri Guru.

Srila Raghunatha dasa Gosvami says in his supplication to Sri Radhika that he had indeed passed some time in a state of expectation which is replete with the ocean of bliss. If She will not give him Her mercy, what does he care about life or residence in Vraja, or about the slayer of Baka (Sri Krishna) Himself? Similarly, if I do not obtain the protecting support of Godhead appearing in the role of His servant, what will it avail me to live in Vraja or to attain Krishna? If the fortune of obtaining the sight of the best-beloved of Krishna is to be missed, I am prepared to give up my little life this day. Where is there any more use for preserving the inanimate body?

What manner of other duty may possibly exist for me that is making me run after it by giving up the service of the lotus feet of Sri Guru? Is the evil fortune of triple misery, which is afflicting the innumerable individual souls of the world, ever acceptable to me? No sooner does vulgar talk come to prevail then it produces addiction to this world as a result. Sri Guru tells of the holy name, then he tells of the divine form as worldly desire begins to subside, of the quality of the divinity on further diminution of such appetite, and he draws us fully to the lotus feet of Sri Krishna by telling us of His activities (lila) and the distinctive nature of individual service when the aptitude for worldliness is still further attenuated. After that we serve the son of Nanda, the highest personality of divine activities, by entering into His pastime.
Is this service obtainable by the physical body derived from parents, by the second birth by means of Gayatri, by admitting to the study of the scriptures or by subsisting on my mental function?

It is from Sri Guru alone that this function may be gained. His lotus feet are eternal. May I never undergo an interruption of relationship with his lotus feet, even for a single moment. May I be never loosened, even for a moment, from the bond that unites me to his lotus feet. May I never for a moment quit my hold of his lotus feet by being tempted by any fascination of this world. May I never be deprived of His lotus feet by listening to the advice of any other, worthless person.

The succession of preceptors commencing from Sri Krishna – Brahma, Narada, and all of them – are my Sri Gurudeva. My Gurudeva designates his preceptor as his Gurudeva. All of them are preceptors of the same chain. There is no difference in them. There is no difference in their utterances. The good fortune that I have gained by obtaining the sight of om vishnupada Sri Sri Gaurakisora Prabhu, my mahanta Gurudeva*[See Endnote 2], I find no language to express. I have observed in him the renunciation of Srila Raghunatha dasa Gosvami in all its perfection. If there be a millionth part of his renunciation in any person, such a person is blessed, indeed; he is most highly blessed. He will be in a position to serve Krishna in the spirit of familiar confidence by climbing upon Krishna's bosom and shoulders.

It is my eternal function to serve the lotus feet of Sri Guru at all times and by means of all the senses. A great day of rejoicing for me has arrived inasmuch as those belonging to the disciplic line of om vishnupada Sri Srila Jagannatha dasa Babaji Maharaja have come here to bless me. This high fortune has not been mine before now. All of you belong to the order of my Gurus. I have wasted your priceless time, devoted to the service of Krishna, by speaking a number of incoherent words, but I have said these words only for worshipping Sri Gurudeva.

Sri Gaurasundara says, "Krishna is Master. He is the autocrat. He is full of activity by His will. All glory, above all things, to His self-willed activities. May He accept my service or reject it as He wishes. I will be prepared to offer Him my exclusive service without guile, at all time and in every way, with body, mind and speech. If He spurns me with His feet I shall know that it is my want of worth."

May the ephemeral world not deflect me for a moment, never make me averse to the lotus feet of my Sri Guru. May Sri Gurudeva be pleased to accept my service. May I never have to associate with evil-minded persons.

I do not know what part of my attempt to worship Sri Gurudeva may be accepted by him, but it fills me with hope that He is more merciful to the undeserving. Holding fast to the hope of his causeless merc y, I will be all the more eager to serve. All of you belong to the line of my Guru. May you have mercy on me that I may be enabled to serve him. I offer my prostrated obeisances at your feet.
ENDNOTE 1:

purisera kita haite muni se laghistha
